name: Bloodfen Ledge
description: A ledge of rust-red rock rising out of the fen. The water around it runs red with iron.

discovery.message: The marsh water turns rust-red around a ledge of iron-rich rock.

face.text: The ledge is slick with marsh water, and the rock bleeds red where the iron runs close to the surface.

leave.text: You shoulder your pack and leave the seam behind.
